# Charts and data displays

How the kit draws a chart and the data displays built the same way: the chart registry and its adapters, breakdowns, the numbers table, legends, the area chart, heat map, share strip and share bill. Not in the CMS itself: an editor places a chart block and an agent writes a `<Chart>` tag, and both pass the one gate in [shared helpers](/src/platform/lib/README.md). Props, variants and where each is used: [shared components reference](/docs/reference/components/README.md); the rest of the kit: [UI kit](/src/platform/ui/README.md).

## How the pieces link

- **Registry and adapters:** `Chart` checks the spec, asks `chartRegistry.ts` for an adapter and draws the key, caption and numbers table around it. The first adapter that supports the kind draws it (`breakdown`; `css` for units; `visx` for bar and stacked); the `text` adapter supports every kind and is last. Chart libraries (`@visx/*`) are allowed only under `adapters/` (`CHART_LIBRARIES` in `eslint.boundaries.config.mjs`; decision 0018).
- **Colours** follow the parts' order, `chart-1` to `chart-6`, from the [theme](/src/platform/theme/README.md)'s chart tokens; `palette: 'warm'` draws orange and gray by marking the root `data-chart-palette`; a seventh part throws, and the spec refuses it first (`chartPalette.ts`, `src/platform/lib/chart/spec.ts`). `LegendSlot` and `SWATCH_COLOUR` in `Legend.tsx` are fixed at six.
- **Numbers and arithmetic** come from [shared helpers](/src/platform/lib/README.md) (`chart/breakdown.ts`, `scale.ts`, `table.ts`); this folder only draws them.
- **Tax picture:** `ShareBill`, `ShareStrip` and `ScaledBreakdown` draw the bill a typed home value produces; the shares are worked out in `src/platform/lib/billShare.ts`, and a bill's slice colours (`shareTones.ts`) are steps of the breakdown chart's ramp.
- **Roadmap:** `AreaChart`, `HeatMap` and `PeriodNav` draw the plan's activity ([roadmap](/src/modules/roadmap/README.md)).

## Behaviors and events

- **`ChartZoom`** moves the same server-rendered chart into a full-screen `Dialog` through the shared `Zoom` and is the chart's only client code; with scripting off the Enlarge button is hidden (`ChartZoom.client.tsx`).
- **`ScaledBreakdown`** redraws a breakdown in the browser with every amount multiplied by a factor, from the same drawing code as `Chart`; it takes a spec the server already checked and never parses it, so no chart library or spec rules (zod) reach the browser (`ScaledBreakdown.tsx`, #1020).
- **`ShareBill`'s total flashes the accent** once each time `pulseKey` changes (`TOTAL_PULSE_MS`, `ShareBill.tsx`, #1351).
- **`AreaChart`, `HeatMap` and `ShareStrip` are server-rendered** with no client code; `HeatMap` with a `selection` turns its days into buttons (`HeatCell.tsx`, #1204).

## Shared pieces it uses

- `Zoom`, `Dialog`, `Card`, `Text` from the [UI kit](/src/platform/ui/README.md); the theme's chart tokens; `lib/chart/*` and `lib/smoothPath.ts` from [shared helpers](/src/platform/lib/README.md).

## Rules and the tests that protect them

- **Every chart carries its numbers as a real table** under "Show the numbers" (closed by default, or for screen readers only with `numbers="screen-reader"`, as in a fact tab); a chart may leave its title and takeaway to screen readers and draws no caption when it has nothing to say (`ChartDataTable.tsx`, `ChartCaption.tsx`, #980, #1144; `ChartDataTable.test.tsx`).
- **An adapter passes one contract:** no `style`, no colour literals, real text, axe clean (`chartAdapter.contract.tsx`; `chartAdapter.contract.test.tsx`, `chartRegistry.test.ts`, `chartLibraries.lint.test.ts`). The browser never gets a library or the spec rules through the zoom (`ChartZoom.imports.test.ts`).
- **A breakdown is drawn at full width:** a grid of squares each worth a fixed dollar amount (whole squares by largest remainder; `hideSquares` leaves the grid out), ranked bars with the main pieces nested under their area, the rest under "See the smaller pieces", colour following size (`chart-ramp-1` to `-7`). Bar length is share times one shared scale, so a dollar is the same length in every breakdown (`adapters/breakdown/`, #866, #943; `adapters/breakdown/breakdownAdapter.test.tsx`, `chartPalette.test.ts`).
- **A bar or stacked chart is drawn large for readers who see poorly:** text at 18 units in a 320-unit drawing, so 16px or more on a 320px phone; bars share one scale shown as short ticks (`adapters/visx/barLayout.ts`, #1206; `adapters/visx/barLayout.test.ts`, `adapters/visx/visxAdapter.test.tsx`).
- **A bill's rows line up:** one grid of name, percent and dollars shared by the rows and the total, the dollar column wide enough for the widest amount, bars on the largest slice's scale (`ShareBill.tsx`, #1163, #1196; `ShareBill.test.tsx`); a strip is one `role="img"` label naming every part and drawing nothing when no part has a share (`ShareStrip.tsx`, #1266; `ShareStrip.test.tsx`).
- **An area chart never dips below a flat stretch:** the curve is monotone, a series of zeros or a `max` of 0 is the flat baseline, one value is a dot, and it has a text label listing every value (`AreaChart.tsx`, `src/platform/lib/smoothPath.ts`, #1190; `AreaChart.test.tsx`).
- **A heat map says all of its values in text,** marks today with a ring, and a day that is not enabled is a muted, slashed square that cannot be pressed (`HeatMap.tsx`, #1191, #1205; `HeatMap.test.tsx`, `HeatMapPeriod.test.tsx`, `HeatMapKey.test.tsx`). `PeriodNav` keeps a direction that cannot go on focusable (`aria-disabled`) (`PeriodNav.test.tsx`, #1218).
- **A legend's columns** are `auto`, `one` or `fit` (by its own width) (`Legend.tsx`, #1333; `Legend.test.tsx`, `chartLegends.test.ts`).

## Boundaries

- Chart libraries are imported only under `adapters/`; this folder imports no module (0008).
